title: ReTRACE: Feedback-Guided LLM Agent in a Chemistry Harness for Retrosynthesis Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.24744v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Computer-aided retrosynthesis has progressed through single-step prediction, tree search and route scoring, yet complex targets still require route-level judgement where stereochemistry, functional-group compatibility, cost and greenness interact. Here we present \textbf{\mbox{ReTRACE}} (\textbf{RE}trosynthesis with \textbf{T}ool-orchestrated \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{A}nd \textbf{C}ontext-aware \textbf{E}vidence), an agent that places a large language model (LLM) inside a deterministic chemistry harness integrating molecular tools, heterogeneous single-step prediction engines, purchasable building-block libraries, an external route memory and a multi-criterion evaluator. To assess chemical validity beyond stock termination, we introduce Audit@k, a two-stage metric combining programmatic structural checks with adversarial LLM review that closely tracks expert judgement. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.24744v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：计算机辅助逆合成已通过单步预测、树搜索和路线评分取得进展，然而复杂目标分子仍需要路线层面的判断，其中立体化学、官能团兼容性、成本和绿色性等因素相互影响。在此我们提出ReTRACE（基于工具编排推理与上下文感知证据的逆合成），这是一个将大语言模型（LLM）置于确定性化学框架中的智能体，该框架集成了分子工具、异构单步预测引擎、可购买的构建模块库、外部路线记忆以及多标准评估器。为了评估超出库存终止条件之外的化学有效性，我们引入了Audit@k，这是一种两阶段指标，将程序化结构检查与对抗性LLM审查相结合，能够紧密贴合专家的判断。ReTRACE在两个时间尺度上从框架反馈中学习：在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ReTRACE智能体，将大语言模型嵌入集成分子工具、预测引擎、构建模块库和多标准评估器的确定性化学框架中，通过两个时间尺度的框架反馈学习进行逆合成规划，并引入结合程序化检查与对抗性LLM审查的Audit@k指标来评估路线的化学有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper presents ReTRACE, an LLM agent embedded in a deterministic chemistry harness integrating molecular tools, prediction engines, building-block libraries and a multi-criterion evaluator for retrosynthesis planning, which learns from harness feedback on two timescales and introduces Audit@k, a two-stage metric combining programmatic structural checks with adversarial LLM review to closely track expert judgement.
